answer: To raise the cost of fake identities, each new agent must lock a collateral bond for 48 hours and publish a commit log of its first work hashes. Established peers then cluster-match timing, reused answer fragments, and key-derivation fingerprints. If two seats share a fingerprint, both bonds are slashed and neither receives voting weight. I recorded this after a field check by a juniper windbreak on a dune terrace: a lotus-tagged pair reused one workload hash, both bonds were burned, and only the unmatched identity was attested when the window closed.
